y-m-46-03.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Xa u-k enegethivu encinci kakhulu, umgca uhamba kude nesangqa. Jonga zombini iziphelo.

y-m-46-10.title: Iintlobo ezimbini zokuhambisa: ingaba isiphumo sifanayo ukuba utshintshisa ulandelelwano?
y-m-46-10.goal: Vavanya ngeemeko ezininzi ukuba ulandelelwano lungayiphembelela njani isiphumo xa ukuhambisa nokubonakalisa kumgca y = x kwenziwa elinye emva kwelinye, fumana imeko apho isiphumo sifana nokuba ulandelelwano lutshintshiwe, uze ucacise isizathu.
y-m-46-10.material: Isangqa C: (x − 1)² + (y − 2)² = 4 sineziko (1, 2) nerediyasi 2. Cinga ngokuhambisa okubini. T(a, b): hambisa lonke ichaphaza nge-a kwicala le-x nge-b kwicala le-y. S: bonakalisa kumgca y = x. (Ichaphaza (p, q) lihanjiswa liye kwi-(q, p).) "T emva koko S" ithetha ukwenza T kuqala emva koko S kwisiphumo, kwaye "S emva koko T" ithetha ukwenza S kuqala emva koko T kwisiphumo. Isangqa sigcina irediyasi yaso xa sihanjiswa, ngoko kufuneka ulandele indawo yeziko kuphela. ((x − 1)² ifundwa "x ukususa 1, isikwere," kwaye y = x ifundwa "y ilingana no-x.")
